Search operators & examples

Keywords: Patronus Harry — ranked by relevance. Exact phrase: "Elder Wand". Boolean: Harry AND (Ron OR Hermione) NOT Voldemort. Wildcards: transfig* or patron?s. Proximity: dementor NEAR/8 patronus, or "Dark Arts" NEAR/5 Snape. Flexible phrase: "defence dark arts"~2. Operators require matches; plain questions use contextual discovery.

Sources and editorial policy

Editorial scope & spell data

Independent reference for personal study, not an official encyclopedia. Entries distinguish Rowling-authored writing from adaptations and imported spell data. Source references are not all verified to individual passages. Coverage is incomplete; shorter entries retain the documented detail available. Spoilers throughout.

The uploaded workbook contains 355 spell-reference rows, including film, game, supplementary and community-compilation content. These are not automatically original Rowling canon. Casting movements and spell lights are shown only where supplied; missing values are omitted.

Imported spell reference: excluded phrases

Full source URLs and original workbook row numbers appear in individual spell entries. The unmodified XLSX is included in the ZIP.

Evidence hierarchy

  1. The seven Rowling novels.
  2. Rowling-authored companions and original essays.
  3. Rowling screenplays (the third co-written with Steve Kloves).
  4. The official stage story with a script by Jack Thorne.
  5. Screen and game-specific additions.

Entries contain editorially written paraphrases and bibliographic pointers. A listed source denotes a relevant book or collection, not independent page-by-page verification. Direct article links appear only where an actual subject-specific page was checked.

No unrecorded incantations, hand motions, light colors, magic power meters, hidden ley-line systems or undisclosed school names are manufactured. Missing facts remain missing.
